item.title: Block Windows Home Intune Enrolment
item.description: With a general lack of management capability for Windows Home devices, should you be allowing them access to Entra ID services, and how do you stop them from enrolling into Intune?

item.title: Blocking Windows Recall Enabled Managed Devices
item.description: Whether we like it or not, AI and Copilot is everywhere, and even if you don’t want AI backed features like Windows Recall enabled on managed corporate and BYOD devices, it will happen. So how do we block these Copilot+ devices from accessing Corporate data or services?

item.title: macOS Google Chrome Platform Single Sign-On
item.description: With all the hype about Platform SSO on macOS devices, now is the time to try out not just the standard functionality, but the integration into web browsers such as Google Chrome. We take a look at how to configure this using Microsoft Intune.

item.title: Device Attributes for Conditional Access Exceptions
item.description: So you like Intune Device Compliance and the integration with Conditional Access, what about if you’ve got VDI or Remote Desktop infrastructure that you want to exclude from specific policies, how do you go about that in a safe and controlled way.
